name: Results Of Adultery
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery, commanding believers not to commit it as stated in Exodus 20:14 and Deuteronomy 5:18. The Old Testament prescribes severe consequences, including death, for both the adulterer and adulteress to remove evil from the community, as seen in Leviticus 20:10 and Deuteronomy 22:22. Jesus deepens this teaching in Matthew 5:27-28 by revealing that even lustful intent in the heart is tantamount to adultery, emphasizing the need for purity not only in actions but also in thoughts.
